```{r, include=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(tseries)
library(DHARMa)

conflicted::conflict_prefer("select","dplyr")
```

# Import files
```{r}
df <- read.csv("Data/regional_integrated_dataset3.csv" )
```

#Bloom Absence/Presence

```{r}
# 1) Binary transformation of bloom absence/presence
bloom_thresholds <- df %>%
  group_by(Regions) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(Chlorophyll,na.rm=T),sd=sd(Chlorophyll,na.rm=T)) %>%
  mutate(bloom_thr = mean + sd) %>%
  select(-mean,-sd)

#mean/d group by region
#HABs vs BABs coming from different dataset
  
df2 <- df %>%
  merge(bloom_thresholds,by="Regions",all.x=T) %>%
  mutate(bloom = case_when(Chlorophyll > bloom_thr ~ 1,
                           .default = 0))

paste0("Number of blooms = ", sum(df2$bloom))


```
# Other Transformations
```{r}
# Create dataframe with pre/post clam dummy variable
df2 <- df2%>%mutate(clam_step=if_else(Year>1987, "post clam", "pre clam"))

```


# Model - Temperature (just to test)
```{r}
bigam <- glm(bloom~ Temperature,family="binomial",data=df2)
summary(bigam)
```
